usage: deskops closeout [-h] {commit,supersede,retire,resolved-by,verify} ...

Workflow closeout operations.

positional arguments:
  {commit,supersede,retire,resolved-by,verify}
    commit              Verify the task's declared closeout evidence, then
                        create the tool-made closing commit, linked to a run
                        evidence directory or marked manual.
    supersede           Close a task whose subject no longer exists, naming a
                        reason and a resolvable ref.
    retire              Remove a task that was already resolved before the
                        ritual lifecycle.
    resolved-by         Close a task whose work already entered the history,
                        naming an ancestor commit and a test.
    verify              Check the closeout evidence the task declared, without
                        committing; print a structured report.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
